description: This Java test class 'ModuleFactoryTest' contains unit tests for testing the behavior of the ModuleFactory component in the OpenMRS core project. It verifies module loading, reloading with version control, dependency management, and error handling features.

classes.name: ModuleFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class that contains numerous test methods to validate module loading, reloading, dependency handling, and error scenarios within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize module state before each test, including shutting down current modules and setting the module list for startup.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Cleanup method annotated with @AfterAll to shut down modules after all tests have run, preventing interference with other tests.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Helper method to load a module from a given location with optional replacement of existing modules.

methods.name: getModuleFiles
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve list of module files to be loaded during tests.
